name: M4 x 12 countersunk screw
summary: Sits flush in a 90 degree countersink, head 8.96 mm across. 12 mm long overall.
source: ISO 10642 values for M4: theoretical head diameter 8.96 mm, head height 2.48 mm, 90 degree head. Unlike a cap screw, a countersunk screw is measured including its head, so 12 mm is the whole screw.
